status.label: Project
status.detail: The public build remains supported while the next generation systems are developed.

status.label: Platform
status.detail: Steam Fallout 4 is the supported game platform.

status.label: Installation
status.detail: Automated installation keeps a 600+ mod setup reproducible.

status.label: Focus
status.detail: Combat, injuries, radiation, scarcity, crafting, and exploration are built around consequence.

coreSystems.title: Combat & Ballistics
coreSystems.description: Lethal caliber-driven combat, physical projectiles, penetration, locational damage, and enemies that do not scale like bullet sponges.

coreSystems.title: Survival & Medical
coreSystems.description: Hunger, thirst, injuries, treatment, sleep, disease, carry limits, and recovery all matter outside combat.

coreSystems.title: Radiation & Weather
coreSystems.description: Radiation is an environmental threat with persistent consequences, dangerous storms, and weather that changes how you travel.

coreSystems.title: Crafting & Progression
coreSystems.description: Unified crafting, specialized workbenches, research, ammunition production, and progression that rewards preparation instead of menu clutter.

coreSystems.title: Settlements & Building
coreSystems.description: Settlement building is being modernized around faster placement, better navigation, free camera control, and compatibility with mod-added objects.

coreSystems.title: Interface & Controls
coreSystems.description: A modern HUD, faster configuration tools, cleaner controls, and custom interfaces replace many of Fallout 4's slow menu workflows.

development.title: Prisma HUD
development.description: A new in-game HUD built specifically for Fallen World instead of stacking more changes on the old interface.

development.title: PrismaMCM
development.description: A faster configuration interface designed to remove the lag and friction of the traditional MCM workflow.

development.title: Settlement Menu Overhaul
development.description: Search, faster browsing, place-in-red support, free camera placement, and compatibility with mod-added workshop categories.

development.title: Core System Pass
development.description: Combat, radiation, weather, stability, startup time, and long-term progression are being tightened together instead of treated as isolated mods.

features.title: Physical Ballistics
features.description: Projectile travel, drop, penetration, and destructible interactions replace purely hitscan gunplay.

features.title: Caliber-Based Damage
features.description: Weapon lethality is driven by ammunition and target protection rather than artificial weapon levels.

features.title: Injury & Medical Systems
features.description: Damage can create injuries that require treatment and affect the player beyond a simple health bar.

features.title: Radiation Overhaul
features.description: Radiation exposure and environmental hazards create persistent pressure during exploration.

features.title: Dynamic Weather Threats
features.description: Dangerous storms and atmospheric conditions can change travel plans and force preparation.

features.title: Expanded World Content
features.description: New quests, locations, enemies, companions, and worldspaces extend the Commonwealth without turning it into a different game.

features.title: Unified Crafting
features.description: Crafting is reorganized around purpose-built benches and consistent recipes instead of duplicated mod menus.

features.title: Ammunition Production
features.description: Break down ammunition, recover materials, and manufacture the rounds needed for a scarce-resource playthrough.

features.title: Pip-Boy Power
features.description: Pip-Boy use has its own power, heat, and wear considerations instead of being a consequence-free pause screen.

features.title: Prisma HUD
features.description: A purpose-built HUD focused on readable survival information and lower UI friction.

features.title: PrismaMCM
features.description: A modern configuration system designed for instant navigation and faster mod settings.

features.title: Settlement Menu Overhaul
features.description: Search, place-in-red, free camera building, and faster access to large workshop catalogs.

features.title: Performance & Stability Pass
features.description: Precombine fixes, crash work, load-time tuning, and curated configuration keep the list playable despite its scale.

features.title: Automated Installation
features.description: Wabbajack reproduces the supported configuration instead of asking players to assemble hundreds of mods by hand.
